items.title: JPMorgan Expects Third-Quarter Gains in Investment Banking, Markets
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase is expecting growth in the “mid- to high-teens” for both investment-banking fees and markets revenue in the third quarter compared with the year-ago period, co-president Doug Petno said Tuesday.  “In investment banking…we started the year with a strong pipeline, we started this quarter with a strong pipeline,” Petno said at a financial services conference hosted by Barclays.  Petno said the bank, which is due to report third-quarter earnings on Oct. 13, is expecting lower markets revenue compared with its record-setting second quarter.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase stock rises after upbeat revenue outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) shares rose 1% on Tuesday after the bank provided an upbeat revenue outlook at a Barclays conference, reversing earlier losses in the trading session.

items.title: The Forgotten Generation Is Broke: 50% of All New Bankruptcies Are 40-59 Year Olds
items.summary: Something unusual is happening inside America's bankruptcy courts, and it has nothing to do with reckless young borrowers drowning in student loans. The age group that should be approaching its financial peak is quietly becoming the face of collapse, and banks are starting to feel it.
